primary: Phase13 direction() on the eight deterministic phase11_geometry.select_patches(mask[::8,::8]) positions. Per-layer median of eight masked population SDs in centred 64 px squares. Arithmetic mean of the 13 medians per end.
mask: Published RGBA mask. Use visible non-black pixels (luminance > 0 and alpha > 0). If RGB is constant and alpha varies, use alpha > 0. Stop on empty or fully uniform support.
decision: Lower mean SD identifies air only if larger/smaller >= 2. Two zero ends are indeterminate. One zero end and one positive end give infinite ratio.
secondary_sampling: Eight uniformly drawn distinct centres from the same 20-step 3x3 eroded 1/8 grid. Primary has no seed.
secondary_descriptors: Over the primary masked patch pixels: pooled mean by layer, maximum-mean and maximum-median-SD layers among the 26 sampled (first tie); pooled fraction <= 2 DN per end on original uint8.
budget_stop: Include PNG header inventory (33 bytes per layer/mask), mask and layer body attempts. Reserve full file sizes before requests, including retries; stop before exceeding budget. No IR, photos or labels.
interpretation: For PHerc0343P, low air makes reversed Z_out; high air makes reversed Z_in; indeterminate leaves both open. Physical training order for 500P2 also requires established render identity.
